chapterInfo.content:
29
Hiob kyerɛ n’ahotɔ a atwam
1Na Hiob kɔɔ so maa n’abebusɛm so sɛ:
2O, sɛ anka mereyɛ sɛdeɛ na meteɛ akane abosome no,
sɛ nna a Onyankopɔn hwɛɛ me soɔ no ɛ!
3 # Dwom 18.28 Berɛ a ne kanea hyerɛn m’atifi,
na mede ne hann menantee sum mu no!
4 # Dwom 25.14 Sɛdeɛ na meteɛ wɔ me twaberɛ nna mu,
berɛ a Nyankopɔn ayɔnkofa wɔ me ntomadan soɔ no;
5berɛ a Otumfoɔ ne me da so wɔ hɔ,
na me mmɔfra nso atwa me ho ahyia,
6berɛ a me nan ho fɔɔ nufosuo mu sradeɛ mu,
na abotan maa ngo asubɔnten senee me hɔ no.
7Mefiri adi mekɔ kuro pono ano,
na mede m’adwa mesi mpraeɛ so a,
8mmeranteɛ hu me, na wɔhunta,
na nkɔkoraa sɔre gyinagyina.
9Mmapɔmma gyae kasa,
na wɔde wɔn nsa butu wɔn ano.
10Mmakoma nne taa dinn,
na wɔn tɛkyerɛma fam wɔn dodom.
11Na aso te a, ɛhyira me,
na ani hu me a, ɛdi me adanseɛ.
12 # Lew 19.18; Eks 22.22 Ɛfiri sɛ na meyi ɔmanehunufoɔ a ɔsu frɛ ɔboafoɔ
ne awisiaa a ɔnni boafoɔ.
13Deɛ ɔreyɛ ayera no nhyira ba me so,
na mema ɔbaa kunafoɔ nya abotɔyam.
14Mefira tenenee na ɛfira me,
m’atemmusɛm te sɛ atadeɛ yuu ne abotire:
15Meyɛɛ aniwa maa onifirani,
na meyɛɛ ɛnan nso maa apakye;
16 # Hiob 31.18 meyɛɛ agya maa ahiafoɔ,
na deɛ menni no no mpo asɛm, mehwehwɛ mu maa no;
17 # Dwom 58.6 na mebubuu omumuyɛfoɔ sebɔmmɔfoɔ,
na mehwim fomfa adeɛ mefirii ne se mu.
18Na mekaa sɛ: Me pirebuo ara mu na mɛgyaa mu,
na mama me nna adɔɔso sɛ anwea.
19Me nhini mu bɛbue ama nsuo,
na obosuo nso atena me mman so.
20M’animuonyam yɛ foforɔ ma me,
na me tadua anya denyɛ foforɔ me nsam.
21Me na wɔtie me na wɔtwɛn me,
na wɔyɛ komm tie m’afotuo;
22me kasa akyi wɔnsane nkasa,
na me nsɛm sosɔ gu wɔn so:
23Na wɔtwɛn me sɛdeɛ wɔtwɛn osutorɔ,
na wɔtrɛ wɔn anomu sɛdeɛ wɔde regye bereamporɔsuo.
24Mesere mekyerɛ wɔn a anidasoɔ abɔ wɔn,
na m’anim a ɛteɛ no, wɔmma no ngu ase.
25Meyii wɔn kwan memaa wɔn, metenaa ase sɛ otitire,
na metenaa hɔ sɛ ɔhene, asafo mu,
sɛdeɛ ɔkyekyere abooboodifoɔ werɛ.

Na Hiob kɔɔ so maa n’abebusɛm so sɛ:
O, sɛ anka mereyɛ sɛdeɛ na meteɛ akane abosome no,
sɛ nna a Onyankopɔn hwɛɛ me soɔ no ɛ!
Berɛ a ne kanea hyerɛn m’atifi,
na mede ne hann menantee sum mu no!
Sɛdeɛ na meteɛ wɔ me twaberɛ nna mu,
berɛ a Nyankopɔn ayɔnkofa wɔ me ntomadan soɔ no;
berɛ a Otumfoɔ ne me da so wɔ hɔ,
na me mmɔfra nso atwa me ho ahyia,
berɛ a me nan ho fɔɔ nufosuo mu sradeɛ mu,
na abotan maa ngo asubɔnten senee me hɔ no.
Mefiri adi mekɔ kuro pono ano,
na mede m’adwa mesi mpraeɛ so a,
mmeranteɛ hu me, na wɔhunta,
na nkɔkoraa sɔre gyinagyina.
Mmapɔmma gyae kasa,
na wɔde wɔn nsa butu wɔn ano.
Mmakoma nne taa dinn,
na wɔn tɛkyerɛma fam wɔn dodom.
Na aso te a, ɛhyira me,
na ani hu me a, ɛdi me adanseɛ.
Ɛfiri sɛ na meyi ɔmanehunufoɔ a ɔsu frɛ ɔboafoɔ
ne awisiaa a ɔnni boafoɔ.
Deɛ ɔreyɛ ayera no nhyira ba me so,
na mema ɔbaa kunafoɔ nya abotɔyam.
Mefira tenenee na ɛfira me,
m’atemmusɛm te sɛ atadeɛ yuu ne abotire:
Meyɛɛ aniwa maa onifirani,
na meyɛɛ ɛnan nso maa apakye;
meyɛɛ agya maa ahiafoɔ,
na deɛ menni no no mpo asɛm, mehwehwɛ mu maa no;

Na mekaa sɛ: Me pirebuo ara mu na mɛgyaa mu,
na mama me nna adɔɔso sɛ anwea.
Me nhini mu bɛbue ama nsuo,
na obosuo nso atena me mman so.
M’animuonyam yɛ foforɔ ma me,
na me tadua anya denyɛ foforɔ me nsam.

Me na wɔtie me na wɔtwɛn me,
na wɔyɛ komm tie m’afotuo;
me kasa akyi wɔnsane nkasa,
na me nsɛm sosɔ gu wɔn so:
Na wɔtwɛn me sɛdeɛ wɔtwɛn osutorɔ,
na wɔtrɛ wɔn anomu sɛdeɛ wɔde regye bereamporɔsuo.
Mesere mekyerɛ wɔn a anidasoɔ abɔ wɔn,
na m’anim a ɛteɛ no, wɔmma no ngu ase.
Meyii wɔn kwan memaa wɔn, metenaa ase sɛ otitire,
na metenaa hɔ sɛ ɔhene, asafo mu,
sɛdeɛ ɔkyekyere abooboodifoɔ werɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
